name: telegram-pro
tagline: Multi-Agent Telegram, With Terminal Channels and HITL in Chat
description: A dedicated bidirectional gateway bot for your org, with forum-topic terminal channels and human-in-the-loop approvals answered right inside Telegram.
shortDescription: Bidirectional Telegram gateway with terminal topic channels and in-chat HITL.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Bidirectional gateway bot, owned and created by you via BotFather
Forum topic terminal channels for live session visibility
Replay-safe webhooks, no duplicate or lost updates on retry
Rate-aware outbound queue that respects Telegram's send limits
Owner onboarding wizard walks you from bot creation to bound group in minutes

gatewayBot.name: Gateway Bot
gatewayBot.description: A single bot you create through BotFather and connect with a token. Quox never asks for BotFather access on your behalf.

terminalTopics.name: Terminal Topic Channels
terminalTopics.description: Forum topics in your Quox Dev group map to live terminal sessions, so you can watch and steer work from Telegram.

replaySafeWebhooks.name: Replay-Safe Webhooks
replaySafeWebhooks.description: Inbound updates are deduplicated and idempotent, so retries and redeliveries from Telegram never double-process.

outboundQueue.name: Rate-Aware Outbound Queue
outboundQueue.description: Outbound messages are queued and paced against Telegram's per-chat and global rate limits automatically.

onboardingWizard.name: Owner Onboarding Wizard
onboardingWizard.description: A 4-step guided setup: create the bot, connect the token, create the Quox Dev group, bind the owner channel.

futureFeatures: Per-agent bot identities, not just one shared gateway bot
Reactions-as-HITL: approve or reject by reacting to a message
/link command to bind a Telegram user to a Quox user identity
Slack Pro under the same contract as Telegram Pro

changes: Bidirectional gateway bot setup via vault-stored token
Quox Dev group detection and owner channel binding
